This twenty-six storey tower isn't for people. It's for pigs.
Ezhou, central China. A cement company builds two pig skyscrapers.
Lifts carry about sixty pigs at a time up to their floors.
Together, the towers can produce over a million pigs a year.
And they need people. More than eight hundred of them.
A vet graduate working there said he earned about twenty thousand yuan a month.
The catch? Before work: shower, a sixty-five degree drying room, then shower again.
A nozzle even shampoos your hair, so nobody skips it.
And staff lived on site for up to two months at a time.
In China, jobs hide in places you'd never look. Find yours at laowai dot ma.
